title: Tessel: The Calendar That Plans Itself
summary: A 33 s monochrome launch film for Tessel, an AI calendar. A single red dot and red 'now' line anchor everything: chaotic event blocks pile up behind 'Your week doesn't fit.', a dark logo reveal, then a clean white app UI where a prompt bar types 'Protect my mornings. Gym Tue + Thu. Ship the deck by Friday.' and the week re-arranges itself. Close-up scenes pair a short left-aligned claim with the UI; it ends on an infinite tilted grid of weeks and 'Everything fits.' Restrained, Swiss, very premium.
fit_reason: Calm, black/white/one-accent UI storytelling with a problem → prompt → result arc; maps directly onto 'one feature' SaaSSuite demos.

palette.mood: light airy, monochrome Swiss with one crimson accent; one dark interlude (#0a0a0a) for the logo

typography.display: tight neo-grotesk bold (Inter Display / Neue Haas Grotesk), very tight tracking
typography.size_behaviour: mixed: medium headline + giant second line ('doesn't fit.' fills the width); later medium left-aligned two-line claims beside UI
typography.notes: Full stops on every claim. Short antithesis lines: 'Meetings move over.' / 'Mornings stay yours.' / 'Overruns fit too.' Red dot replaces the full stop on 'Everything fits'. Small grey subline under logo: 'The calendar that plans itself.'

small headline over a giant full-width second line ('Your week / doesn't fit.')
AI prompt bar typing a natural-language request with highlighted tokens, then the UI rearranges

best_segments.what: Red dot on time line, chaotic blocks pile in, 'Your week / doesn't fit.' blur reveal
Prompt bar types request with token chips, click send, UI rearranges in 3D tilt
Left-aligned claims beside zoomed calendar crops: blocks turn black, overrun shifts with +30 min badge
Pull back to endless tilted grid, 'Everything fits' with red dot, logo end card

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion: rebuild calendar in HTML/CSS, filter: blur() tweens for per-word reveals, CSS 3D perspective for the grid pull-back, motion blur via directional blur or frame blending; one accent colour token.
recreate.prompt: Minimal white Swiss-style SaaS launch: a single crimson dot and time line thread through every scene, calendar blocks pile up around a bold tight grotesk headline, an AI prompt bar types a request and the week rearranges itself, ending on an infinite tilted grid and a one-line claim.
